description: Edit the post's CURRENT image in place (same path as the in-app chat image edit). Default keeps everything else the same; brand marks are left out unless the instruction asks for them. The replaced image is appended to generation_metadata.image_history so bamf.revert_post_version can restore it. Pass reference_version (an image_history index) to also give the editor an earlier version. Always updates post_id; never creates a post. Returns an async job. If the post's design is a Claude HTML design (Made with Claude), the edit runs Edit with Claude instead: a new design version the post shows (poll bamf.get_design); reference_version/source_image_url are refused there.

source_image_url.description: Optional base image to edit instead of the image the post shows now. Must be this post's current image, an image_history entry or one of its design versions (bamf.list_post_versions). Use it right after choosing a new base so the edit cannot land on the older image.

name: bamf.edit_post_image
